description: This file defines the Doctrine ORM entity class 'License' for the 'ohrm_license' database table. It includes properties for id and name, and a one-to-many relationship with 'EmployeeLicense' entities, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: License
classes.description: Entity class representing a license with id and name, related to EmployeeLicense entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the id of the license.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the id of the license.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the license.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the license.
